name: pixelagents
short: Pixel Agents webview bundle and office-state schema boundary
description: Builds the pinned Pixel Agents webview and provides the validated, lazy-initialized office-state facade used by cctv, floorplan, architect, and painter. Corridor owns the opaque persisted aggregates; this cog owns their Pixel Agents schema interpretation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each Discord account's office character (a pixatar seed code and the character profile it stands for), keyed by user id.
install_msg: Requires corridor (auto-loaded). Bot owner only: `[p]pixelagents webview commit` to see the pinned commit, `[p]pixelagents webview rebuild` to force a rebuild, `[p]pixelagents pixatar` for the pixatar CLI that deals office characters. cctv serves the built webview.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
